single_purpose: Provide local PDF compression and page-management tools, plus JPG/PNG-to-PDF conversion, within Chrome.

remote_code.declaration: No remote executable code is used. The PDF.js worker, processing worker, and PDF.js WebAssembly assets are bundled locally in the extension package.

locally_processed_data.data: PDF files selected by the user, including their document contents and file metadata
locally_processed_data.purpose: Preview, compress, merge, split, extract, delete, reorder, rotate, or number PDF pages
locally_processed_data.storage: Held in extension memory while loaded in the workspace and released when cleared or the workspace closes; no extension-side persistent storage is used

locally_processed_data.data: JPG and PNG files selected by the user, including image contents and file metadata
locally_processed_data.purpose: Create a PDF with one image per page
locally_processed_data.storage: Held in extension memory while loaded in the workspace and released when cleared or the workspace closes; no extension-side persistent storage is used

locally_processed_data.purpose: Return the result for user-directed download
locally_processed_data.storage: Held in workspace memory until replaced, cleared, or the workspace closes; downloading does not itself clear the workspace.

privacy_dashboard_disclosure.user_directed_exports: The extension creates a browser download only after the user chooses Save.
privacy_dashboard_disclosure.dashboard_collection_answer: PPDF handles user-selected PDFs, JPGs, and PNGs locally to perform its stated features. It does not collect or transmit the documents, their metadata, or operation telemetry. A publisher link opens its selected website in the browser; any request data handled by that website is separate from extension processing.
